hero.title: Get in Touch
hero.description: Have questions about your next adventure? We're here to help you plan the perfect trip.

fields.label: Your Message
fields.placeholder: Tell us about your dream trip...

questions.question: How far in advance should I book my trip?
questions.answer: We recommend booking at least 2-3 months in advance for popular destinations, especially during peak seasons. However, we can also accommodate last-minute bookings based on availability.

questions.question: What is your cancellation policy?
questions.answer: Our cancellation policy varies by trip type. Generally, cancellations made 30+ days before departure receive a full refund. We also offer travel protection plans for added peace of mind.

questions.question: Do you offer group discounts?
questions.answer: Yes! We offer special rates for groups of 6 or more travelers. Contact us for a customized group quote.

questions.question: Are flights included in the trip price?
questions.answer: Trip prices typically don't include international flights unless specified. We can help you find the best flight options to complement your package.

questions.question: What travel documents do I need?
questions.answer: Requirements vary by destination. Our team will provide detailed information about visa requirements, vaccinations, and other documentation needed for your specific trip.

questions.question: Can I customize my trip itinerary?
questions.answer: Absolutely! All our trips can be customized to match your preferences, budget, and travel style. Our travel designers will work with you to create your perfect journey.
